# Phong Phan — Dev Portfolio & UI Registry

> A pixel-perfect dev portfolio and modern component registry built natively on TanStack Start, Tailwind CSS v4, and Base UI.

Personal portfolio and engineering showcase of Phong Phan. Frontend Engineer specializing in the TanStack ecosystem, React 19, TypeScript, fluid micro-interactions, acoustic UI design, and production-grade component architectures.

## UI Components & Primitives

- [Line Nav](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/navigation/line-nav): Minimalist animated line navigation with spring-physics indicators, scroll-spy integration, and orientation variants. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/line-nav.json`)
- [Middle Truncation](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/text/middle-truncation): Canvas-measured binary search text truncation preserving the start and end of strings with responsive resize sync. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/middle-truncation.json`)
- [Card](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/card/card): Displays a card with header, content, and footer. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/card.json`)
- [Scroll Area](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/data-display/scroll-area): Augments native scroll functionality with auto, hover, and always visibility modes, custom variants, scrollbar gutter reserve, keyboard navigation, and high-contrast styling. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/scroll-area.json`)
- [Drawer](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/interactive/drawer): An interactive overlay and bottom sheet component powered by Base UI with swipe-to-dismiss, snap points, nested stacks, customizable positions, and inset or straight variants. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/drawer.json`)
- [Unboxing Bucket](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/interactive/unboxing-bucket): Interactive 3D unboxing container animation with emerging spring-physics feature chips. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/unboxing-bucket.json`)
- [Time Scrubber](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/interactive/time-scrubber): Tactile physics-based time dial with spring momentum, fling kinematics, rolling blur digits, and sub-pixel tick rendering. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/time-scrubber.json`)
- [Code Block](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/data-display/code-block): Syntax-highlighted code surface powered by Shiki with line numbers, line highlighting, collapsible blocks, diff mode, and copy actions. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/code-block.json`)
- [Map](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/data-display/map): High-performance interactive vector map powered by MapLibre GL with dark/light themes, custom markers, popups, controls, routes, arcs, GeoJSON, and clustering. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/map.json`)
- [Text Hover Effect](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/text/text-hover-effect): Interactive typographic SVG reveal effect that traces strokes on mount and reveals a vibrant radial gradient mask following cursor movement. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/text-hover-effect.json`)
- [Background Gradient Cursor](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/background/background-gradient-cursor): Interactive ambient canvas surface featuring cursor-tracking radial mask, procedural dots, dynamic grid lines, and directional linear gradients. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/background-gradient-cursor.json`)
- [Isometric Monogram Mark](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/interactive/pp-mark-isometric): Interactive 3D voxel isometric monogram mark featuring procedural diagonal hatching, wireframe edges, cursor-tracking radial flashlight, and spring press physics with audio feedback. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/pp-mark-isometric.json`)
- [Isometric Block Typography](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/text/phong-phan-isometric): Horizontal 3D block typography extruded along an isometric blueprint grid, equipped with interactive dynamic lighting, sound feedback, and edge-to-edge/padded layout variants. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/phong-phan-isometric.json`)
- [Spotlight Card](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/card/spotlight-card): Interactive surface with radial cursor spotlight illumination, dynamic 1px masked border glow, and smooth 3D tilt perspective. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/spotlight-card.json`)
- [Border Glow](https://byphongphan.com/component-ui/card/border-glow): Interactive surface with cursor-tracking mesh gradient edge illumination, outer atmospheric aura, and entry sweep animation. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/border-glow.json`)

## Interactive Blocks

- [Not Found 01](https://byphongphan.com/blocks/404-page/not-found-01): A 404 page with a playable brick breaker game. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/not-found-01.json`)
- [Not Found Gravity](https://byphongphan.com/blocks/404-page/not-found-02): Interactive 404 error page with 2D physics gravity, falling blocks, and draggable elements. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/not-found-02.json`)
- [Not Found Pixel Trail](https://byphongphan.com/blocks/404-page/not-found-03): Interactive 404 digital void experience featuring dynamic cursor pixel trails and terminal status diagnostics. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/not-found-03.json`)
- [Login 01](https://byphongphan.com/blocks/auth/login-01): Split-screen modern authentication screen with photography hero, tracked typography, and full dark mode support. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/login-01.json`)
- [Stats Cards 01](https://byphongphan.com/blocks/marketing/stats-cards-01): Overlapping interactive marketing stats cards with spring physics hover, metrics showcase, and dark mode support. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/stats-cards-01.json`)
- [Koi Background](https://byphongphan.com/blocks/marketing/koi-background): Interactive ambient koi pond background surface featuring fluid dynamics, water caustics, multi-joint fish flocking, and mouse-feeding mechanics. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/koi-background.json`)

## Custom Hooks

- [useMediaQuery](https://byphongphan.com/r/use-media-query.json): React hook for responsive design and media query listening with SSR support. (CLI: `pnpm dlx shadcn add https://byphongphan.com/r/use-media-query.json`)
